published_scope: Explicitly released sanitized aggregate observations only; private cases, manifests, logs, raw outputs, keys and ciphertext are not released.
purpose: New frozen-protocol performance observation of three entry classes on two exact sources; not a verbatim rerun of an earlier protocol or whole-project acceptance.
H2_method_classification: Explicit post-SUT preparation-method revision, not first blind test, mechanical equivalence, or a replacement of H1.
R_vs_H_vs_SUT: Every R is its request/workflow commit, H2 is the frozen tester code commit, SUT is the opaque product source commit; R is not the environment origin. Ten bound neutral implementation files and H2 tester tree were verified when constructing every R.

criteria_and_statistics.p95_method: nearest rank over every recorded request in the operation group, including failures and requests completing during drain; not successful-only latency
criteria_and_statistics.latency_scope: Client wall elapsed from immediately before async request to observed response return or exception; includes client scheduling/network/proxy/server effects, excludes subsequent synchronous body/schema validation on successful responses. It is not server execution time.
criteria_and_statistics.throughput_numerator: Driver oracle-successful primary target requests completed inside [steady start, steady start+600s), counted in ten half-open 60s buckets. Preparation, warmup, controls, planned negative cases, and drain completions are excluded.
criteria_and_statistics.http_zero_meaning: No HTTP response observed before client failure, not an HTTP status sent by the product.
criteria_and_statistics.planned_negative_error_meaning: Failure means frozen tester expectation mismatch; it is not automatically a confirmed product fault.
criteria_and_statistics.full_request_raw_recording: Every recorded request has compact timing/status/failure/phase/op/VU/sequence metadata in a hash-checked compressed trace. No request payloads or credentials are released.
criteria_and_statistics.response_schema_sampling: 867 attempts schema checking on every response reaching that step; other classes use first and every 1000th per-user sequence, plus setup/postcheck. Earlier status/code assertions can prevent schema checking. Actual completed schema-check count was not separately recorded and is unknown.
criteria_and_statistics.minute_audit_limit: Saved per-group minute counters are published without the broken criteria aggregation. Trace group counts/status/failures/P95/max were independently decoded and matched. Exact independent minute realignment is unavailable because trace-relative origin was not serialized alongside phase monotonic timestamps.

common_fixture.write_preparation: Public HTTP only; SELECT-only scoped count verification; no local database or prior environment reused.
common_fixture.representative_state_mix: 3000 historical tasks (2500 delivered and 500 rolled) plus 3000 pending; 11500 reviews and 3500 decisions; shallow dependency graph. Synthetic fixture data, not student work.
common_fixture.actors: 18 synthetic developers, one synthetic reviewer, and bootstrap manager; credentials remain private.

868.target: Task state transitions and real task detail/list/history reads
868.request_ratio_note: Closed-loop user allocation is fixed; realized operation request ratios differ with latency. No explicit retry or state resynchronization after uncertain mutations.

867.nominal_candidate_mix: 75% valid and 25% planned invalid by sequence
867.target_throughput: Only successful nominal-valid validation; planned rejection latency/status are reported separately and never credited to target successes.

866.target: New escalation HTTP admission and separate asynchronous notification observation
866.logical_user_mix: 400 dual-step users: task schedule write followed, only on success, by new escalation request
866.target_concurrency_limit: This is not 400 simultaneous escalation HTTP requests. Preparation is separately measured and excluded from target latency and success throughput.
866.notification_observation: Bounded diagnostic after HTTP phase; taskbook has no invented end-to-end notification latency threshold. It was not reached successfully in these runs.

method_findings.finding: Client scheduling validity is not established. Samples can show 400 logical users/inflight bookkeeping while the same event loop is delayed; these are not independent wire-level or server concurrency measurements. Severe loop lag and substantial CPU use occur in several runs. No exclusive cause is established.

Async 5s request and 20s usage-command budgets did not impose hard wall-clock bounds under scheduling delay. Observed request latency and usage call elapsed can exceed them; actual elapsed is retained, not clamped.

867 frozen oracle overconstrains one 422 time-range category to CONTRACT_INVALID. The frozen OpenAPI explicitly allows TIME_RANGE_INVALID for that relation. Its occurrences are tester oracle mismatches, not established product contract violations. Original FAIL/exit remains. Other negative HTTP200 observations require separate specification adjudication; this performance report does not declare a new functional defect.

Frozen criteria aggregation skips a primary group after any failure, incorrectly omitting its successful throughput/P95 from the criteria summary. Published observed group statistics and minute counts retain those successes; the original FAIL is not reversed. criteria.no_unexpected_failures is a criterion label, not evidence that zero failures occurred.

Mutation postchecks compare persisted audit/event totals with acknowledged successful replies. Requests that time out may already have committed. Their count mismatch and subsequent stale-version 409 cannot alone prove duplicate execution, invalid state, or persistence corruption. No automatic retry/resynchronization or oracle relaxation was performed.

Both 866 steady windows contain preparation requests only and zero target escalation requests. Target HTTP P95 is null/NOT_MEASURED, and delivery correctness/lag remains unestablished; a 600s scheduled window is not a completed target performance exercise.

environment_limits.container_cpu_memory_limits: Docker CpuQuota/CpuPeriod/NanoCpus/Memory/MemorySwap were 0; this does not mean infinite hardware.

api_process_observation.meaning: Configuration declares four workers; the explicit read-only detector did not establish four spawned worker processes. No process census beyond this neutral interface was authorized.

nginx.meaning: Current nginx -T configuration observation; last-reload identity not proven.

environment_limits.background: Consumer, bootstrap-scoped 60s scanner and health probes remained enabled; other traffic is unknown.
environment_limits.placement: Each source/entry used a new hosted environment, six overlapping workflow runs. Harness runner view and local-unix Docker daemon relation observed; physical co-location, independent physical hardware, exclusive CPU and external traffic attribution are unknown.
environment_limits.container_usage: Fixed six-service single Docker snapshots. CPU percent is snapshot-window Docker CPU percent, can exceed100%; Linux CLI memory subtracts cache and is not RSS. Network/block strings are formatted cumulative quantities, not throughput or utilization. PIDs include kernel threads. Six services are not sampled atomically. Snapshot max is not full-window peak. Null/error/invocation failures remain unknown.
environment_limits.repetition: One observation per source/entry, no repetition/randomized crossover; no S1/S2 ranking or SUT-only causality.

runs.preparation_duration_interpretation: From tester report start to first scoped fixture-count receipt; includes initialization, accounts and control overhead. This is not a teacher performance bound.

client_observation.cpu_ratio_interpretation: Process CPU seconds / first-to-last sampler wall span across warmup, steady and drain; not whole-machine utilization or proof of exclusive bottleneck.
client_observation.max_rss_interpretation: Linux getrusage max RSS of the load generator process only, KiB; not per-service RSS.

in_window_sampling.meaning: Bookkeeping samples only, not proof of wire/server concurrency or continuous responsiveness. Irregular sampling and unobserved gaps remain.

postcheck_observation.interpretation: Count mismatch is real; an acknowledgement-only equality oracle cannot distinguish late committed timeout requests from a product invariant violation. No duplicate-execution conclusion.

bounded_future_method_suggestion.scope: Validate the load driver separately from either SUT before any newly authorized formal round.
bounded_future_method_suggestion.method: Use one deterministic isolated local stub with fixed bounded responses, both immediate and delayed paths, 400 logical users for a short fixed cap, and an independent wall-clock watchdog. Compare issued/completed/status counts, live transport concurrency, event-loop delay and timeout wall bounds; verify time-origin serialization and minute aggregation with a known schedule. Keep schema-validation cost visible and account for observer overhead. Do not reuse these results as SUT performance evidence.
bounded_future_method_suggestion.authorization: No new request, test run, H2 edit, or automatic formal rerun has been started.
